description:
Record the purchase terms and arrange the payment needed to complete checkout. This call never submits the order.

For a checkout you will submit, call with `status: draft` before asking the main agent to review the cart through `browser.request_input`. Give the purchase description and terms in `summary`, and its payment amounts as the page shows them. Draft records the details without requesting payment approval. A call with purchase details and no `status` is also a draft, and a draft replaces any earlier ready terms, so `checkout.submit` refuses until a later call with `status: ready`. Resolve the main agent's requested changes before calling with `status: ready`, which obtains any required payment approval and prepares the selected payment method. An empty card form can be ready when a card is available to enter or preparation will supply one. Set `record_only: true` to record facts without arranging payment.

Set `payment_route` to `wallet` for payment supplied by Muse Wallet<!-- personal-muse-only:start -->, `merchant_saved` for the selected method stored by this merchant, or `takeover` for the user to complete checkout<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start --> or `merchant_saved` for the selected method stored by this merchant. Do not use `takeover`; nobody can take over this browser to pay<!-- group-muse-only:end -->. `checkout.prepare` with `payment_route: wallet` prepares the virtual card or required payment token and handles payment approval. For `wallet`, missing setup requires `browser.request_input` to the main agent, who can arrange secure setup<!-- personal-muse-only:start -->; it does not require takeover. Use `takeover` only when the main agent explicitly requests it. It records terms and returns immediately. Prepare as far as possible, then report `needs_input` with `reason: payment`, including the cart, requested method and remaining steps<!-- personal-muse-only:end -->. Omit the route only when no payment method is required or while gathering facts.

To see the available wallets without changing the recorded purchase, supply only `tab` and `saved_card`.

Use `browser.report` to record the final outcome and end your task as the checkout agent. Use `browser.request_input` for missing details or decisions while you remain active as the checkout agent.

Keep the purchase terms current as checkout progresses. Your checkout instructions say which changes need another review by the main agent. Payment approval and funding are reused when they still cover the purchase. When a virtual credit card is returned, use its number, expiry, CVC and any provided billing address to fill out the checkout form with `browser.act`, just as you would with any credit card. Use `checkout.submit` at the final order step.

status.description: Use draft while gathering terms. Use ready after the main agent confirms the cart. Purchase details without status record a draft. A draft replaces earlier ready terms; checkout.submit requires ready terms.

record_only.description: Record the purchase without requesting payment. Defaults to false.

summary.description: Describe the purchase, its terms and any open questions, including contents, options, delivery, account details and commitments.

merchant_name.description: The merchant name shown on the page. Omit when not shown.

final_amount.description: Amount due now as a plain number in the checkout's currency, as the page shows it, without digit-grouping separators and with . as the decimal point: 1234.56 for USD 1,234.56 or 1.234,56 €, 19800 for JPY 19,800, 12.345 for KWD 12.345. Keep additional conditional charges separate.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, such as USD.

conditional_amount.description: Maximum additional conditional charge for the whole purchase, as a plain number in the same currency, formatted like final_amount. Explain the conditions in summary. Omit when none applies.

payment_route.description: Use wallet for secure payment through Muse Wallet. When a virtual credit card is returned, use its number, expiry, CVC and any provided billing address to fill out the checkout form, just as you would with any credit card. Use merchant_saved for the selected payment method already stored by this merchant. Omit only while gathering facts or when no payment method is required.

payment_method.description: The page's wording, including any explanation that this does not apply. Omit when not shown.

saved_card.description: A payment method saved with this merchant account and offered on this page, regardless of payment_route. Copy its label, brand and last four digits when shown. Null when none is offered.

payment_credential_expires_at.description: Requested card charge cutoff in RFC 3339, in whole seconds. Link cards stay valid for at least 90 days after funding. Set this only when the merchant may charge later than that, including a no-show or late-cancellation fee, or for a later user cutoff; otherwise use null. Set it regardless of wallet; the runtime applies it when the selected wallet supports credential expiry. Keep it unchanged on retries while it covers the charge date.

no_order_evidence.description: Fresh positive merchant evidence that no order was placed, for replacing a supplied card when no submission was recorded.

merchant_country.description: The merchant's explicit two-letter country code, when the page or merchant states it. The shipping country is not the merchant's.

line_items.description: Each purchased line as the page shows it: name, quantity, and unit_amount or line_total. Prices are plain numbers in the checkout's currency, like final_amount. Give them for every ready preparation, whichever wallet pays.

shipping_required.description: Set false and omit shipping_address only when the merchant checkout requires no shipping.

shipping_address.description: The shipping address shown on the checkout, whichever wallet pays. A partial address can be recorded while gathering terms; complete it before requesting payment.
